description: Editable prompt vocabulary used by the prompt.* operations. Change values here to tune wording for your own models and house style. Slot order defines the order of the positive prompt.

concept-art.description: Environment, character, prop or creature concept sheet

product.description: Clean product shot on a controlled surface

slots.lighting: softbox key light with gentle fill

slots.composition: group photo, everyone visible, clear spacing

ignored.change: move the ignored noun to the start of the prompt and give it one clear attribute

merged.change: separate the merged concepts with a clause break or use regional prompting

anatomy.change: simplify the pose and add anatomy negatives; if persistent, use masked repair
anatomy.test: one pose term plus anatomy negatives

composition.change: add one explicit framing term (wide shot, medium shot, close-up)

style.change: keep one style term and remove conflicting style words

text.change: remove requested lettering from the prompt and add typography in a deterministic design tool

latent.beginner: A compressed numerical version of an image that the model edits instead of raw pixels.
latent.practitioner: The VAE-encoded representation (e.g. 4 channels at 1/8 resolution for SD-family models) in which denoising happens.
latent.technical: Tensor z = E(x) in a learned low-dimensional space; denoising operates on z and the decoder D maps back to pixels.

seed.beginner: A number that makes the random starting noise repeatable.
seed.practitioner: Same seed plus same settings should reproduce the same image on the same software and hardware.
seed.technical: Initial noise z_T ~ N(0, I) drawn from a PRNG initialised with the seed; reproducibility also depends on kernels and precision.

sampler.beginner: The method that removes noise step by step.
sampler.practitioner: Different samplers trade speed against detail and stability; compare them with the same seed.
sampler.technical: A numerical solver (e.g. Euler, DPM-Solver++, DDIM) that integrates the reverse diffusion ODE/SDE.

scheduler.beginner: Decides how much noise is removed at each step.
scheduler.practitioner: Controls the noise-level sequence; often paired with a sampler.
scheduler.technical: Maps step index to noise levels sigma_t or timesteps t.

cfg.beginner: How strictly the image should follow the prompt.
cfg.practitioner: Classifier-free guidance scale; too high causes harsh contrast and artifacts.
cfg.technical: eps_guided = eps_uncond + s*(eps_cond - eps_uncond) with guidance scale s.

vae.beginner: The part that turns the compressed image back into pixels.
vae.practitioner: A bad VAE can cause colour shifts or black images; test with a fixed seed.
vae.technical: Variational autoencoder encoder/decoder pair used for latent compression.

checkpoint.beginner: A saved model file with learned image knowledge.
checkpoint.practitioner: A base model (e.g. SD1.5, SDXL, SD3-class) whose architecture determines compatible add-ons.
checkpoint.technical: Serialized weights (e.g. .safetensors) for the UNet/transformer, text encoders and VAE.

lora.beginner: A small add-on file that teaches a model a style, subject or concept.
lora.practitioner: Low-rank adapter; rank and strength control how strongly it applies.
lora.technical: W' = W + (alpha/r)*B*A with low-rank matrices A and B.

controlnet.beginner: An add-on that makes the image follow a pose, edge or depth map.
controlnet.practitioner: Use a preprocessed map plus a strength and a start-end step window.
controlnet.technical: A trainable copy of encoder blocks that injects spatial conditioning into the denoiser.

inpainting.beginner: Regenerating only the masked part of an image.
inpainting.practitioner: Needs an image, a mask and a denoising strength; feathering the mask blends edges.
inpainting.technical: Conditioned denoising where unmasked latents are kept or re-noised from the source.

upscaling.beginner: Making an image larger with more detail.
upscaling.practitioner: Classical resampling is predictable; AI upscaling can add detail but may invent it.
upscaling.technical: Super-resolution by interpolation or learned models (e.g. ESRGAN-class).

denoising strength.beginner: How much of the source image may change.
denoising strength.practitioner: Low values preserve the source; high values allow larger change.
denoising strength.technical: Fraction of the noise schedule applied to the encoded source before denoising.

embedding.beginner: A small learned word that represents a concept.
embedding.practitioner: Textual inversion embeddings are short token vectors trained for a concept.
embedding.technical: A learned vector inserted into the text-encoder token sequence.

ip-adapter.beginner: An add-on that uses a reference picture to guide style or subject.
ip-adapter.practitioner: Balance reference weight against the prompt to avoid copying the reference.
ip-adapter.technical: Image-prompt adapter that injects reference image embeddings through decoupled cross-attention.

negative prompt.practitioner: Use short, specific terms; overlong negatives can suppress wanted detail.
negative prompt.technical: Unconditional branch text in classifier-free guidance.

eval_templates.identity: a portrait of {subject}, neutral expression, plain background
eval_templates.flexibility: {subject} in a rainy city street at night
eval_templates.leakage: {subject} on a beach at sunrise, wide shot
eval_templates.memorization: {subject} in an unusual pose, cropped composition
eval_templates.anatomy: {subject} with hands visible, holding an object
eval_templates.adherence: {subject} with exactly two objects beside it, one red and one blue
